_comment: Made-up Confluence pages for the mock (scripts/requirements-sync/mock-atlassian.mjs). Bodies are Confluence storage format (XHTML).

pages.title: Checkout keyboard access
pages.body:
Shoppers who use a keyboard must be able to pay.

Acceptance criteria

  • THE SYSTEM SHALL let a shopper reach every checkout control with the Tab key.
  • WHEN focus is on a payment method THE SYSTEM SHALL select it with the Space key.

Notes

From the 2026 accessibility review.

pages.title: Retry a declined payment
pages.body:
Acceptance criteria

Given a declined card

When the shopper picks another card and pays

Then one order is placed

pages.title: Confirmation page shows delivery estimate
pages.body:
Acceptance criteria

  • WHEN an order is confirmed THE SYSTEM SHALL show a delivery estimate of 3–5 working days.
